p: one who gives two perutot to a woman and says to her: With one
be betrothed to me today and with one be betrothed to me after I divorce you,
Rabbi Yirmeya, who had been dozing, woke up
he redeemed them to where others redeemed them?
This is what Rabbi Yoḥanan said:
they do not become consecrated again,
is considered as if others redeemed her.

p: others redeemed them they do not become consecrated again
one who takes a vow … from seafarers,
one who takes a vow that he will not derive benefit from seafarers,
from those who live on dry land.
from those who live on dry land,
those who live on dry land.
but rather one who customarily departs [lefaresh]

with regard to the first clause … and one teaches … with regard to the latter clause. … The one who teaches … with regard to the first clause teaches … like this: … One who takes a vow … from seafarers

with regard to the first clause of the mishna, and one teaches it with regard to the latter clause. The Gemara explains: The one who teaches it with regard to the first clause teaches it like this: One who takes a vow not to derive benefit from seafarers
from those who live on dry land.
